capabilities: Toggle a minimalist writing view that covers other panes and app chrome
Customize font, type size, line height, line width, and page colors
Enable or disable typewriter scrolling and sentence focus
Restore the prior workspace and scroll position on exit
Assign a hotkey to enter and leave the writing view
extras: The README states the plugin has no network access or telemetry, does not edit Markdown, and stores settings through Obsidian; no hotkey is assigned by default.
intentEvidence: I wanted to bring a little of that feeling to Obsidian.
motivation: The author wanted to bring the feeling of writing on an Olivetti Lettera 32 — a page, a keyboard, and room to hear one's own thoughts — into Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's interface surrounds the editor with panes and app chrome, and there is no built-in way to step into a calmer writing view without closing your layout.
summary: A minimalist writing mode that toggles a quiet, distraction-reduced view of the current note and restores your workspace when you leave.
